about_the_game:
In this turn-based dungeon crawler, you get to know four girls that make up the continent's best adventure club, as you all enter the imaginary fantasy land of Anastasia to play that you're heroes that go into treacherous dungeons and defeat dangerous enemies, before going home to a relaxing sleepover and a fairy-tale marathon.

Features:

* A heartfelt story about friendship featuring quirky characters and a surreal setting.

* A turn-based battle system with a focus on special attacks.

* A deep meta-narrative layer with multiple endings.
